main.bio: Hi, I am Vasu Sharma. I am a Software Engineer. I love Computer Science in general and specifically interested in Computer Networks, Operating Systems. I am interested in end to end software development and like to develop consumer applications.I can adapt to changing tech-stacks or new technology in general very quickly.Computer networks really fascinate me.I have worked on some cool freelancing projects and am always looking for project ideas involving new challenges.I am a travel-geek and I only have coffee on days ending with 'y' :p

work.title: Software Engineer
work.description:
Working on AI Security Solutions targeting OWASP Top 10 risks for LLMs.

Previously, worked in GCP's Secret Manager team to develop a new service for Google Cloud Platform (yet to be GA) [Go, Spanner, gRPC, Continuous Probes for E2E testing]

work.title: Application Engineer
work.description:
Worked on standardizing the active device telemetry data collection from datacenter hardware (adopting redfish industry standard) for data-center data-security team. We handled billions of events daily from across the fleet. [C++, PubSub, RPCs, Spanner].

Also, designed and developed(founding team member) a centralized "Policy Manager" for creating and enforcing Cloud Capacity Policies with policy versioning, RBAC, runtime evaluation engine using Common Expression Language.. [Java, Angular, gRPC, Spanner]

work.title: ML Research Intern
work.description:
Researched on novel techniques for optical character Recognition (OCR) for machine printed and handwritten text. Implemented CRAFT research paper, changed the model architecture and trained on relevant data to suit the requirements.

Strengthened ML deployments of OCR jobs by shifting workloads from compute instances to containerized ML pipeline on Kubernetes (async) increasing load tolerance and availability and also saving costs.[Azure, Python, Redis, Kubernetes]. Built a full stack application for continuous human feedback of low confidence predictions and setup automated retraining pipeline for model based on evaluation.[Azure, Python, NodeJS, React]

work.title: Summer Intern
work.description: Added features to and re-designed the primitive UI for configuring workflows with React and TypeScript to make it consistent across the firm and reduced the user on-boarding time from 3 weeks to few days.

work.title: Freelance Developer
work.description:
Built a real Email Classification engine for Hotstar (client of NanoStuffs), deployed the same AWS. [Python,Machine Learning,AWS].

Worked on web scraping projects, scraping data from Yelp and other online reviews websites into structured format. [Python, Selenium].

Worked on building Web UIs and REST APIs serving results from daily OCR scans of newspapers.[Python, Django, Javascript]

work.title: Software Developer
work.description:
Built a website for Indian Medical Association - https://imamssss.com to manage their Social Security Scheme - developed UI and backend components from scratch including integration of payment gateway, admin dashboard for managing active members, advance and recurring payments from members and generating payment invoices in realtime etc. [NodeJS, React, MongoDB].

Built an online election portal for conducting elections for College Presidents during the times of covid. Wrote middle-wares for extensive validations, added OTP support, used MongoDB transactions for recoding votes atomically built user interfaces for managing all phases of elections from nominations to voting. Self hosted on college servers and did extensive load tests. [NginX, React, MongoDB, NodeJS ].

Developed a resume-builder web application in vanilla JS , PHP for creating user resumes by ingesting information from an interactive form. This was integrated with the web portal of Pune StartUp Fest where 3000+ candidates created their resumes directly sent to Start-Ups for applications.

projects.category: Built Android and Desktop Applications to share files, voice call and text message users connected to the same WiFi network.The app is completely server-less and uses peer-to-peer connections for all its functions and works without Internet.Live on Google Play Store.

projects.title: Milaap
projects.category: Milaap a decentralised video/audio chat/conferencing application, which is designed to work on the edge, with very less interference of the server(i.e. peer to peer connection). There are many video calling applications around the globe, but they are mostly server based applications providing maximum load on the server, wherein the audio and video quality decreases with increase in the number of participants. Many don't even support end-to-end encryption. So we decided to develop a one-stop solution for not only addressing all these solution, but to give a seamless experience to the user. It is designed to work efficiently on all platform
